description:
The Zoning designations are defined in Schedule B of the Summerland's [Zoning](https://www.summerland.ca/planning-building/zoning). A list of amendments can be found in section 16 of the Zoning Bylaw. The corresponding bylaw number and adoption date are also captured in this dataset. 
The online information is provided for the convenience of our residents and clients and should not be used as a reference in decision-making when buying real estate, finalizing development proposals or seeking building permits. Please [contact](https://www.summerland.ca/your-city-hall/contact) the Development Services Department for more information.

The District's description above references 2 documents whose link on summerland.ca no longer resolves, so the reference is given as plain text rather than a broken link.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: ArcGIS object identifier assigned by the source service. Stable within one extract; not a durable key across refreshes.

table:columns.name: BylawNo
table:columns.description: The publisher documents no alias or code list for this column. Measured in this copy: 869 of 941 rows populated; 79 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Adopted
table:columns.description: The publisher documents no alias or code list for this column. Measured in this copy: 869 of 941 rows populated; 64 distinct values.

table:columns.name: ZoningNew
table:columns.description: Current zoning designation, as a zone code from the Zoning Bylaw. This is the live column despite the name: its ArcGIS alias is "Zoning". All 38 distinct values match the layer's own uniqueValue renderer. The service also publishes a Zoning_Update coded-value domain for this field, but that domain is stale — it lists RSD1, RSD2, RSD3, RDH, RPN, RSH and RSD1(i), which appear in no row, and omits RU1, RU2, RU3, MX1 and CD10, which do. Treat the renderer, not the domain, as the current code list.

table:columns.name: Zoning
table:columns.description: Zoning designation in force before June 2024, carried forward by the District. Its ArcGIS alias is "Zoning Prior to June 2024". Use ZoningNew for current zoning.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, in EPSG:26911 (NAD83 / UTM zone 11N) as the District publishes it. Reproject to EPSG:4326 to join against WGS84 data.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box, the GeoParquet 1.1 covering used for spatial predicate pushdown. Derived, not upstream data.

title: Zoning
